title: Screen rotation issue.
symptom: After rotating from portrait to landscape and back to portrait, the screen does not properly resize. This started after installing the Feb 20 nightly and persists in later nightlies on Android 10 devices.
cause: The issue appears to be caused by Android 10, as updating to Android 11 resolved it for users. The thread suggests it is a problem caused by Android.
fix: Updating to Android 11 resolved the issue for users. For those unable to update, installing the latest manufacturer updates may help, but no definitive fix is provided.
evidence_quote: Incidentally, updating to Android 11 fixed it
